inputs.text: [excited] PLAT… ee… oh… SOR… us. [curious] In Greek, "platus" means wide, flat.
[happily] That's its name, yes — [amazed] even though it wasn't flat at all. [calm] It lived in Europe, in Germany, France, and Switzerland, two hundred ten million years ago.
[curious] Two hundred ten million? Is that before T. rex?
[confident] Way before. [proud] Plateosaurus is one of the very first big plant-eating dinosaurs in all of history.
